node.statement: For every continuous map, singular-cohomology pullback preserves degree, cup products, and the unit; hence mu^*:H^*(M;reals)->H^*(M times M;reals) is a degree-preserving unital algebra homomorphism, and composing it with the degree-preserving unital ring isomorphism kappa^(-1) gives the same properties for Delta.
